title: Production Boundaries & Capstone
description: Study least-privilege capabilities, budgeting and concurrency limits, versioned rollout and rollback, and capstone: a recoverable research workflow. Each lesson includes a worked example and an applied practice task.

lessons.title: Least-privilege capabilities
lessons.description: Design capability sets for researcher, editor and publisher roles.
lessons.conceptOverview: Grant each worker only the tools and data needed for its role. Separate read, draft and commit capabilities, and enforce permissions outside generated text so a model decision cannot enlarge authority.
lessons.whyItMatters: Tool authority should be enforced by the application.
lessons.engineerDeepDive: Grant each worker only the tools and data needed for its role. Separate read, draft and commit capabilities, and enforce permissions outside generated text so a model decision cannot enlarge authority.

sections.title: Practice & verification
sections.content: Design capability sets for researcher, editor and publisher roles. Write down your reasoning and check it against the concept before continuing.

keyTakeaways: Tool authority should be enforced by the application.
commonMistakes: A prompt telling a worker to be careful replaces access controls.

lessons.title: Budgeting and concurrency limits
lessons.description: Allocate a verification reserve and define a budget-exceeded outcome.
lessons.conceptOverview: Bound runs by steps, wall time, tool cost and concurrency. Reserve capacity for recovery and expose a clear incomplete state when a budget ends rather than claiming success.
lessons.whyItMatters: Budgets should include verification and recovery work.

sections.title: Practice & verification

keyTakeaways: Budgets should include verification and recovery work.
commonMistakes: A run that reaches its step limit should be marked successful.

lessons.title: Versioned rollout and rollback
lessons.description: Plan a migration and rollback test for suspended runs.
lessons.conceptOverview: Version instructions, tools, state schemas and evaluation fixtures together. Roll out to a small cohort with measurable gates, and ensure old persisted runs remain compatible or are migrated safely.
lessons.whyItMatters: Agent releases must account for durable state compatibility.

lessons.title: Capstone: a recoverable research workflow
lessons.description: Deliver a state diagram, tool contracts, fault fixtures and a run report.
lessons.conceptOverview: Build a bounded workflow that retrieves evidence, drafts a report and checks citations using deterministic tool fixtures. Include a denied source, a timeout and a crash after artifact creation; verify safe resumption.
lessons.whyItMatters: A production-style capstone demonstrates recovery and evidence integrity.
